title: Vintage & Exotics MV Agusta Brutale 1000 RR (Urban Carbon)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the MV Agusta Vintage & Exotics MV Agusta Brutale 1000 RR (Urban Carbon) is engineered for responsive agility and high-rpm engine exhilaration. At its heart lies a 1000cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
